'''Defel-nator This Deal Seems to Not Be So Bad Sometimes''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Defel-nator]]
* '''Published:''' 5 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Deal Defel-nator DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Get the deal going and then occupation and just crush them.

Use the usual Mob Points for executor and IC to grab Piett or Thrawn or Ozzell to piolet and get the free executor and still drop guys for the deal...

If I can get Molotor (V) out then only Maul will have to pay extra for Goo Nee Tay...

I am looking for suggestions for this deck... I am scared of Han and Chewie in the Falcon in a Senate Deck in Space, or at the Sector...  so that is why furry fury and ghhhk and so forth... On the ground it seems that my guys are too expensive sometimes...

thanks for comments
